guidelines: A strong resume should be concise and easy to scan.
Project descriptions should explain what was built, technologies used, and the candidate's contribution.
Good resume bullet points should include measurable results whenever possible.
Avoid generic phrases such as hardworking, passionate, quick learner, and team player without evidence.
Technical skills should be relevant and supported by projects or experience.
Students should showcase meaningful projects that demonstrate practical technical ability.
Resume formatting should be consistent and easy to read.
Avoid listing technologies that the candidate cannot confidently explain in an interview.
jokes: Teri formatting bilkul teri career ki setting jaisi hai — dekhne mein sab kuch bhara hua lagta hai, lekin asar bilkul zero.
Jaise tu mazak-masti mein paida hua, waise hi yeh resume bhi mazak mein bana diya. Seriousness naam ki cheez kahin nazar nahi aa rahi.
Tera skills section aisa hai jaise teri life ke decisions — bahut kuch try kiya, kuch bhi pakka nahi kiya.
Tera experience section bilkul teri commitment jaisa hai — description lamba hai, asar chhota.
Achievements section teri baatein jaisa hai — sunne mein badi lagti hain, asar nahi karti.
Teri skill list aisi hai jaise teri weekend plans — bahut kuch likha hai, follow kuch nahi hota.
Yeh resume itna dangerous hai ki ATS isko scan karte hi crash ho jaye. Software bhi nahi seh pa raha tera confusion.
Isse achha tha tu resume banata hi nahi. Ab dekh ke lagta hai future mein bhi dark days hi aane wale hain.
Recruiter tujhe select kare isse pehle uska resignation letter ready rehta. Itna strong effect hai tere resume ka.
Padhte waqt ek hi khayal aata hai — “kaash main isse pehle blind ho jaata”. Aankhein bach jaati.
Yeh padhne ke baad recruiter sochta hoga “main is field mein kyun aaya”. Career choice pe hi regret hone lagega.
